title: system-atlas skill builds explorable isometric maps from one data file
summary: system-atlas is an agent skill that renders an explorable isometric map of a codebase, agent, or pipeline from one data file with progressive disclosure, hover details, and a generated markdown twin that stays in sync.
question_it_answers: How can agents explore a large system architecture visually instead of reading walls of docs?

claims.text: The atlas uses progressive disclosure chapters that reveal a few boxes at a time instead of dumping the whole system.
claims.evidence: chapters reveal the system a few boxes at a time instead of all at once.
claims.subject: infographics-diagrams

claims.text: A markdown twin is generated from the same data file so documentation cannot drift from the visual atlas.
claims.evidence: the md twin is generated from the same file so it can't drift
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge
